context_files.purpose: Verbatim owner direction that the research target is better action over increasing agent lifetimes after competitors flatten, rather than engineering throughput.
Project thesis, organism, measurement doctrine, and current claim limits.
Experiment-to-claim ladder, required baselines, planner interface, capacity accounting, and on-policy firewall.
Unratified PCFL-Stream and prospective-schema design that supplies the proposed causal-cohort construction.
Human-required minimal J/P construct-validity and four-pair DEV-only spending-gate contract.
Human-required CPU interface-isolation backend correction and exact noncoverage of model, learning, scaling, and paper evidence.
Mandatory deliberation, exact human ratification, independent review, and GPU/scientific-claim authority boundary.

system_thesis_interpretation: PCFL-Stream is a credible single-family paper target only if it is treated as a controlled response-surface benchmark of compiled per-life memory, not as a miniature proxy for every part of the lifelong-agent thesis. Its strongest construct is: from a target-blind public action--outcome prefix containing an increasing count of independent causal mappings, can one frozen base/resolver plus a per-life memory preserve old mappings, acquire newly introduced mappings, and combine mappings across eras to improve later fixed-budget action after raw history no longer fits? The one-family design is scientifically coherent because lifetime, dependency depth, evidence age, memory substrate, capacity, and causal binding can be crossed on matched lives and targets, permitting failures in compilation, storage, resolution, or composition to be localized. It is not by itself a naturalistic or on-policy continual-learning benchmark: source lives are common and immutable, mappings are synthetic independent permutations, and evaluation actions do not improve the subsequent experience distribution. A confirmatory pass may therefore support a benchmark-specific causal action-improvement claim and, separately, same-corpus parametric-transport evidence. It may support only a bounded empirical compression claim if exact incremental memory bits are sublinear relative to a frozen sufficient-statistic denominator at noninferior action value, or a prospective schema claim if a precommitted abstraction improves a genuinely fresh sparse cohort beyond all local atoms. It cannot support generic self-improvement, autonomous discovery, faster learning, unbounded continual learning, generic intelligence, or saturation of unnamed SOTA systems. The minimal J/P G1 is merely a separately ratified DEV admission screen for semantic use, and BWRAP_CPU_INTERFACE_ISOLATION is merely a non-model one-host interface receipt; neither is confirmation data, a sample-size contribution, or authority for PCFL implementation, model access, GPU work, or claims.
graph_delta_interpretation: The proposed PCFL_STREAM_PAPER_TARGET node should be accepted as the sole candidate family, conditional on a preregistered confirmatory protocol that turns its axes into estimands rather than labels. The common immutable life and target set must be blocked across arms, but the independent replication unit is a freshly generated world--life (with all targets, cohorts, sides, calls, and model samples nested); repeated targets or seeds do not increase n. Each cohort must add a generator-certified independent causal assignment and an exact increase in the minimal sufficient statistic, not merely a new label, paraphrase, exposure, or replay. Each evaluation item needs a matched counterfactual twin with identical target-visible bytes and a different optimal decisive action, plus target-only Bayes and fitted shortcut controls. Depth must mean independently certified causal dependency length, not number of prompt steps, and depth cells must be matched on target-visible marginals, action horizon, chance value, and cohort age so that depth, lifetime, and age are not confounded. Exact public-evidence graph/program systems should be split into a feasible public baseline and an oracle/witnessed ceiling; a hidden-truth-produced graph is not a competitive baseline. The MJP_G1_TO_PCFL_STREAM_SPENDING_GATE edge is acceptable only with the word DEV operationally enforced: a green four-pair screen may motivate a separately ratified calibration, but its .85-style model rule, four pairs, data, interface-isolation receipt, prompts, and outcomes do not enter paper inference or choose confirmation thresholds. The TEXT_CAUSAL_USE_TO_MATCHED_LORA_TRANSPORT edge is necessary but not sufficient for fairness: text and LoRA must bind the exact same canonical corpus root and target-blind writer snapshot, while model/base, target set, candidate universe, resolver API, action caps, and stochastic seeds are paired; corpus exposures, training tokens/FLOPs, retrieval/index work, prompt tokens, latency, and incremental retained bytes remain separate ledgers. Recognition-assisted LoRA, unaided LoRA, and external-text retrieval are distinct treatments, because recognition and candidate enumeration can supply cognition that must not be credited to weights.
loop_delta_interpretation: The lifetime loop is well aimed but must be frozen as two noncommunicating phases: calibration/DEV may select feasible checkpoint locations, budgets, implementations, capacity grids, and a smallest scientifically useful effect; confirmation uses newly generated, never-inspected world--lives and cannot modify those choices. A stronger confirmation split holds out whole world--life roots and target templates; if robustness beyond one renderer or cohort schedule is claimed, a second generator-level holdout must prospectively vary those nuisance factors without changing the causal quotient. Every arm begins from an identical base and common source-life prefix, receives a fresh per-life memory state, and has no cache, adapter, index, summary, model conversation, or provider state shared across arms or lives. At each checkpoint the compiler freezes before targets and arm assignment are exposed. New, old, and cross-era targets must be fully crossed with certified depth wherever the construct permits; structurally impossible cells must be declared before outcomes rather than silently omitted. Constant maximum query, reasoning, and action caps are a legitimate fixed-budget stress test only after an independent typed/public-evidence controller achieves itemwise value 1 at every lifetime-by-depth-by-age cell; otherwise cap failure is benchmark invalidity, not evidence against a memory arm. Report actual work as well as caps. Masking must remove the complete decisive cited memory cut while preserving interface shape. Authentic-twin substitution must make behavior follow the substituted assignment; when scored in the original world the wrong-twin plan should lose value. Mere action change is insufficient causal evidence. The stop conditions should be claim-specific: failure of unique-knowledge growth invalidates the lifetime construct; text causal-use failure stops LoRA attribution; LoRA failure narrows the result to compiled text; absent baseline plateau removes only saturation/crossover language; linear candidate work removes scalable parametric-read language; linear retained capacity removes compression language; and scripted source lives always retain the on-policy prohibition. None of these stop outcomes may automatically dispatch a repair or successor run.
claim_delta_interpretation: One PCFL-Stream family can support a paper if the headline is a benchmark-specific causal lifetime response surface, with named systems and explicit resource frontiers. The primary confirmatory claim should decompose into co-primary or ordered estimands: post-native overall action-value change; new-cohort acquisition against target-only/no-memory and named strong baselines; old-cohort retention as a predeclared noninferiority contrast to an earlier eligible checkpoint; and cross-era constructive advantage at matched depth. An aggregate cannot compensate for forgetting or failed acquisition. The phrase learning rate should be avoided unless a longitudinal slope or area-under-curve estimand is explicitly defined; the owner clarified that better eventual action, not faster early learning, is the hypothesis. Baseline saturation is an optional additional claim, earned baseline by baseline through an equivalence-style plateau definition, never through nonsignificance or because PCFL wins at the endpoint. The plateau margin must be justified before confirmation from score resolution, assay reliability, and a scientifically meaningful action difference; a simultaneous confidence region for every predeclared later increment must lie inside that margin for at least the predeclared number of consecutive post-native intervals, while PCFL must meet its separate growth/endpoint criterion on the same range. Three post-native points provide only two increments and are an identifiability floor, not proof of plateau; power simulation may require more points and pairs. Claims about other systems must name the exact frozen implementations and tuned resource envelopes; no generic SOTA-saturation or external-validity wording follows from category labels. Same-corpus text-versus-LoRA evidence can attribute substrate transport or deployment tradeoffs, not intelligence to LoRA alone. A fixed-rank adapter that succeeds over a finite range can support only bounded empirical storage/compression wording, with exact bits and value loss reported; asymptotic or unbounded language requires an algorithmic bound or much stronger evidence. PCFL-Schema, if included, is a separately gated prospective sub-rung within the family and cannot rescue a failed independent-cohort PCFL-Stream result. The on-policy flywheel claim remains retired because the source experience distribution is fixed.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The four information classes express the correct firewall but six aggregate stages are not enough to certify it. Before implementation, expand each cell to every causal descendant that can encode hidden truth or prior results: world/target constructor, renderer, handle and cursor allocator, source scheduler, twin transform, compiler, claim verifier, corpus serializer, tokenizer, substrate assigner, trainer, checkpoint selector, indexer, embedding/candidate generator, prompt builder, model conversation/cache, resolver, parser, action executor, scorer, resource monitor, audit sink, and suffix/confirmation generator. For each component bind allowed bytes, forbidden bytes, output descendants, ordering, length, error shape, timing/retry behavior, cache/reset boundary, and post-exit consumer. Target-visible bytes, candidate sets, prompts, failures, and work budgets must be exhaustively identical across target twins until the assigned memory treatment is introduced; a fitted target-only shortcut must remain at the enumerated Bayes value. The compiler must be blind not only to hidden answers but also to target templates, later cohort allocation, arm identities, capacity choices selected for confirmation, and all earlier arm outcomes. The LoRA trainer may see only the exact frozen compiled corpus and a treatment-specific training manifest, never evaluation targets or scores. Arm blinding at the model interface should use a common API and constant-shape errors; if the model can infer substrate from different APIs, that interface difference is part of the treatment and the claim must say so. Offline scoring may see hidden truth only after complete action/citation transcripts freeze. The J/P Bubblewrap receipt cannot be inherited as model-facing isolation for PCFL, especially for any interactive observation path; PCFL requires a new exact execution and visibility scope.
acceptance_test_interpretation:
PCFL_PS_T01_UNIQUE_KNOWLEDGE_AND_NATIVE_CONTEXT_AXIS should be modified before implementation. Accept only if an independent literal generator audit proves total/rejection-free construction, cohort-assignment independence, exact target-twin visible-byte equality, zero hidden-conditioned selection, thirteen genuinely new supported mappings per completed cohort, and monotone minimal-sufficient-statistic bits. Compute L_native from the frozen tokenizer and full worst-case model-visible envelope. Treat one pre-native plus provisional 2x/4x/8x points and three post-native points as coverage candidates, not universal thresholds: freeze locations only after CPU feasibility and blinded power/identifiability simulation, require every point to add comparable new knowledge, and prohibit curve/plateau language if too few powered increments remain.

PCFL_PS_T02_FIXED_BUDGET_ACTION_CAUSALITY_AND_DEPTH should be modified. Freeze a graph-theoretic definition of certified depth 1--4, an independent solver certificate, matched item-generation marginals, and a complete lifetime-by-depth-by-new/old/cross-era cell manifest. The same maximum caps may be used only if a target-blind typed controller using eligible public memory scores itemwise 1 in every valid cell; actual calls, tokens, candidates, latency, and actions are also reported. Credit causal use only when authentic memory succeeds, complete-cut masking lowers value beyond a preregistered paired margin, and authentic-twin substitution makes the decisive action/citation follow the twin assignment while matched wrong-twin memory scores incorrectly in the original world. Report unconditional and authentic-success-conditioned intervention effects; retain malformed, timeout, and missing-evidence cases as failures. Depth 1--4 bounds the demonstrated range and cannot support generic deep-reasoning language.

PCFL_PS_T03_STRONG_BASELINE_AND_SAME_CORPUS_FACTORIAL should be modified. Before confirmation, bind executable definitions and tuning protocols for every claimed baseline, using the same base-model version, source lives, targets, public tool availability, action caps, and calibration allocation. Distinguish honest native context, summary/reflection, episodic RAG, linked memory, public-evidence graph/program, and hidden witnessed oracle; the latter is a ceiling. Bind the same compiled-corpus bytes for text and LoRA, equalize reader/candidate conditions in matched contrasts, and keep recognition-assisted and unaided LoRA separate. Report corpus exposures, prompt/context tokens, index/embedding bytes, candidate enumeration, training and inference FLOPs/calls, latency, and incremental retained bytes. Compare Pareto/resource-matched points as well as best calibrated performance; a baseline is not weak merely because its natural resource allocation differs. Acceptance requires that conclusions survive the strongest correctly implemented named baseline, not every category label by fiat, and that failed or dominated LoRA narrows rather than invalidates a possible compiled-text result.

PCFL_PS_T04_CAPACITY_QUERY_AND_SATURATION_RESPONSE_SURFACE should be replaced by a fully prospective estimand contract. Freeze raw and normalized action-value definitions, the normalization reference, active versus retained byte counting, adapter precision, index/embedding/pointer inclusion, training and query compute ledgers, capacity/rank grid, and all interpolation/model choices. The grid must contain fixed-capacity, resource-matched, and growth-reference points selected without confirmation outcomes. Define each named baseline's plateau by simultaneous equivalence intervals around all later predeclared increments, using a scientifically justified margin and consecutive-interval count chosen before confirmation; nonsignificance is not plateau. Separately require powered PCFL cumulative post-native improvement and endpoint advantage, new-cohort acquisition superiority, old-cohort noninferiority, and cross-era superiority under the declared multiplicity hierarchy. Empirical candidate-work slopes over a few checkpoints do not prove sublinear complexity: require a reviewed algorithmic work bound or use only observed-range language. Compression requires exact incremental bits or bytes to grow sublinearly relative to the minimal sufficient statistic while action value satisfies a predeclared noninferiority margin; otherwise say compiled parametric storage.

PCFL_PS_T05_SPLIT_STATISTICS_FAILURE_AND_PROMOTION_LOCK should be modified and is mandatory before any model/GPU request. Freeze whole world--life calibration and confirmation roots, target/template/cohort/depth/age allocations, optional generator-level robustness holdout, all model/training seeds, and exact model/provider versions. Derive the number of independent world--life pairs and seeds from blinded variance estimates or conservative simulation for the smallest scientifically useful effect under the full intersection/ordered claim; do not borrow the J/P four-pair DEV size or count nested targets as replicates. Predeclare pair-blocked estimators or hierarchical model, cluster bootstrap/randomization procedure, simultaneous intervals and multiplicity family, noninferiority/plateau margins, missing/timeout/malformed scoring as zero unless a predeclared environment-wide NOT_RUN condition applies, duplicate retention, exclusion rules, and no optional stopping. Calibration may tune; confirmation may only execute the locked protocol. A failure may narrow or motivate a newly ratified study, never alter or extend confirmation.

PCFL_PS_T06_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW_AND_CLAIM_FIREWALL is accepted with strengthening. A fresh reviewer must receive exact design and analysis preregistration, source and environment closures, generator/oracle proofs, split roots, complete arm and reset manifests, model/provider versions, corpus/adapter/index roots, target-twin and masking traces, baseline tuning receipts, raw pair-level outcomes including failures, and resource ledgers before author conclusions. The review must map every passed estimand to a prewritten claim sentence and explicitly reject unsupported compression, SOTA-wide saturation, autonomous discovery, naturalistic external validity, on-policy flywheel, generic intelligence, and unbounded continual-learning language. An author advocate is separate and cannot override rejection; repaired bytes or analyses require fresh bound review. A green review still cannot create human model/GPU/scientific-claim authority.
assumptions: The exact change.json and seven context-file hashes listed here are the complete authorized evidence for this independent benchmark interpretation; no other interpretation has been read.
Both referenced J/P and Bubblewrap consensuses remain human_required on their face, so their proposed tests or receipts are unavailable unless separately ratified and completed.
A PCFL-Stream world--life is independently sampled from a frozen total generator; cohorts within a life are independent hidden causal assignments but remain nested observations for inference.

All arms use the same frozen base model, resolver policy version, source-life bytes, evaluation targets, and target-independent compiler output unless the treatment definition explicitly changes one factor.
Every per-life adapter, external index, text store, conversation, cache, and working state is reset between independent world--lives and is never shared across evaluation arms.

Targets and their counterfactual twins can be constructed without rejection or hidden-truth-conditioned rendering, and hidden optimal actions can be scored only after model-visible transcripts freeze.
The benchmark's public source actions are fixed for causal attribution; evaluation action gains therefore do not change future source evidence and cannot establish on-policy learning.
No checkpoint count, pair count, effect margin, rank grid, model threshold, or plateau rule from the minimal J/P DEV instrument transfers automatically to PCFL-Stream.
Exact public graph/program baselines can be implemented from eligible public evidence without hidden proof paths; any hidden-witness version is labeled only as a ceiling.
This artifact interprets design only and supplies no implementation, model, network, provider, GPU, experiment, promotion, or scientific-claim authority.

ambiguities.question: What exact per-item action-value function, chance/Bayes reference, normalization, clipping rule, and pair aggregation define normalized action value?
ambiguities.impact: Without one frozen metric, difficulty-dependent normalization or aggregation can manufacture lifetime growth and conceal new/old/cross-era failure.

ambiguities.question: How many independent world--life pairs and model/training seeds will confirmation use, what variance source is permitted, and what smallest scientifically useful effects power the design?
ambiguities.impact: Targets and cohorts nested in one life cannot substitute for independent pairs; an unspecified n makes uncertainty, noninferiority, and plateau claims non-auditable.

ambiguities.question: Are 2x, 4x, and 8x L_native feasible fixed points, provisional geometric anchors, or claim requirements, and what happens if serialization or compute makes a point invalid?
ambiguities.impact: Post-outcome checkpoint changes or an underpowered three-point curve enable optional selection and overstate scaling.

ambiguities.question: What exact causal graph, solver, minimal dependency cut, and matching constraints certify depths one through four independently of action length and target difficulty?
ambiguities.impact: If depth is prompt steps or correlated with age/chance/action horizon, the depth response surface has no construct validity.

ambiguities.question: What equivalence margin, onset rule, number of consecutive increments, response model, and simultaneous uncertainty criterion define a named baseline plateau?
ambiguities.impact: A nonsignificant slope or endpoint loss is not evidence of saturation; the central comparative claim otherwise remains unfalsifiable.

ambiguities.question: Which exact algorithms, prompts, indices, reflection schedules, graph builders, training recipes, and calibration budgets instantiate each broad baseline label?
ambiguities.impact: Category names do not ensure strong baselines, and arbitrary weak implementations would invalidate superiority or saturation language.

ambiguities.question: Which contrasts are matched on incremental retained bytes, active bytes, context tokens, candidate work, end-to-end compute, latency, or cost, and which are intentionally Pareto comparisons?
ambiguities.impact: Text, retrieval, graph, and LoRA systems spend resources differently; one hidden budget can make the preferred substrate appear superior.

ambiguities.question: What exact minimal sufficient statistic, precision convention, adapter byte count, and permitted action-value loss define fixed or sublinear compression over the observed range?
ambiguities.impact: Parameter count or fixed rank alone does not establish compression of independent causal mappings.

ambiguities.question: Does confirmation hold out only random world--life roots, or also renderer templates, cohort schedules, skins, and prospective schema regime families?
ambiguities.impact: Within-generator replication supports a narrow benchmark claim; broader robustness or paper-generalization language needs a predeclared generator-level holdout.

ambiguities.question: Is the target-blind compiler a fixed learned policy, prompted teacher, deterministic program, or mixed pipeline, and what evidence licenses the word amortized?
ambiguities.impact: A hand-engineered or oracle-assisted writer can test memory transport but cannot support an agent-compiles-its-own-life claim without precise attribution.

ambiguities.question: Which failures score zero at pair level, which invalidate a whole environment as NOT_RUN, and are any exclusions allowed after dispatch?
ambiguities.impact: Unfrozen failure handling permits favorable deletion and changes both performance and resource estimands.

ambiguities.question: Is PCFL-Schema a preregistered confirmatory sub-rung in this paper family, an optional follow-up only after PCFL-Stream, or fully deferred?
ambiguities.impact: Compression and abstraction language depends on this scope; a post-hoc schema study cannot rescue or reinterpret an independent-cohort result.

ambiguities.question: How are repeated LoRA training exposures to the compiled corpus compared with per-query text retrieval exposures and end-of-life batch SFT?
ambiguities.impact: Identical corpus bytes do not by themselves equalize information exposure or compute, so transport and efficiency conclusions can be confounded.

ambiguities.question: Which lifetime-by-depth-by-age cells are structurally possible, and how are missing cross-era or old-target cells declared and weighted?
ambiguities.impact: Silent empty cells or changing cell mixtures can create Simpson's-paradox lifetime curves and hide forgetting.

ambiguities.question: What frozen model/provider version, decoding settings, seed semantics, nondeterminism audit, and repeated-call policy apply to every arm?
ambiguities.impact: Backend drift and pseudoreplicated calls can dominate small benchmark differences and break paired comparisons.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: At least three post-native checkpoints and provisional 2x/4x/8x L_native positions are not sufficient acceptance criteria for a scaling or saturation claim.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Three points yield only two increments, and their power depends on pair variance, ceiling/floor effects, checkpoint spacing, and the effect margin. Geometric token multiples also need not be geometric in unique causal knowledge or compute.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Retain them only as provisional coverage anchors and an identifiability floor. Freeze the final count and locations from pre-confirmation feasibility and blinded power simulation, require monotone unique-knowledge growth, and limit claims if powered consecutive increments are unavailable.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Depth 1--4 and constant resolver/query/action caps cannot be accepted until depth and budget sufficiency are independently certified itemwise.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Nominal chain length can covary with chance value, age, action horizon, or number of visible anchors; one cap can also truncate deeper cells and turn benchmark invalidity into an apparent memory failure.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Define graph-theoretic minimal depth and complete decisive cuts, match nuisance marginals, and require a target-blind eligible-memory controller to score 1 in every valid crossed cell under the exact caps before any model run. Bound all depth claims to the tested range.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposal requires a prospective plateau but does not define a falsifiable baseline-specific estimand.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Failure to reject positive growth is not equivalence to zero, and calling a baseline saturated because PCFL wins confounds absolute plateau with relative advantage.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: For each named baseline predeclare an equivalence margin justified by assay resolution and scientific utility, an onset and consecutive-interval rule, and simultaneous intervals for every later increment. Test PCFL growth and endpoint advantage separately on the same range.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Listing strong baseline classes and saying budgets are matched is insufficient for a paper-scale comparison.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: External text, linked memory, graphs, and LoRA allocate storage, training, retrieval, context, and computation differently; weak recipes or a single favorable capacity point can decide the result.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Freeze exact implementations and equal calibration opportunities, report multi-resource ledgers and Pareto/frontier comparisons, sweep preregistered capacities, and distinguish feasible public-evidence graph baselines from hidden oracle ceilings.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: No paper decision may inherit the J/P four-pair DEV sample, .85 semantic threshold, .80 twin diagnostic, or choose a new round threshold without an explicit confirmation design.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The referenced consensus states that four pairs support no confidence interval or population claim. Targets, sides, depths, cohorts, calls, and seeds are nested and cannot inflate the independent sample size.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Choose the confirmation pair and seed counts from blinded variance or conservative simulations for predeclared minimal effects under multiplicity and intersection/noninferiority requirements; use pair-blocked inference and retain every failure and duplicate.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The expected condition that behavior changes under decisive-memory masking is too weak for causal action credit.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Masking can trigger arbitrary different errors, and post-hoc cited atoms can be incomplete. A change alone does not show that authentic bindings supported the correct action.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Predefine the complete decisive cut, require a paired loss of action value under shape-matched masking, require twin substitution to redirect the decisive plan to the twin-valid action, and report both unconditional and authentic-success-conditioned effects.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: A few checkpoint measurements cannot by themselves establish sublinear query work or scalable parametric recall.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Finite-range slopes are sensitive to index thresholds, caching, candidate-set construction, and constant overhead and do not prove an asymptotic property.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Require a reviewed algorithmic candidate-work bound with all hidden enumeration counted, or restrict wording to the observed lifetime range and publish the complete candidate/work curve.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposed compression criterion remains too permissive if it treats fixed rank or sublinear adapter bytes alone as sufficient.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Compression is relative to an information denominator and an acceptable loss. Finite-capacity weights may appear compact through quantization conventions, base-weight exclusion, or deteriorating action value.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Freeze exact incremental bit/byte accounting, compare against the minimal exact sufficient statistic and atomic representations, require sublinear growth with predeclared action-value noninferiority, and call a finite-range result bounded empirical compression only. Keep prospective schema generalization as a separate route.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The aggregate six-stage visibility matrix does not enumerate the descendant channels already found fatal in the J/P review.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Truth or prior outcomes can leak through rendering, handles, ordering, candidate sets, prompt length, training manifests, retries, caches, timing, and evaluator branches even if the named high-level stage is marked forbidden.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Expand the matrix component by component, bind constant-shape descendant behavior and reset boundaries, and prove exhaustive target-twin byte equality up to treatment installation before implementation.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Freezing generic world-life splits is not enough if claims extend beyond random seeds of one renderer and schedule.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Holding out targets inside familiar lives measures interpolation and risks compiler or baseline tuning to generator artifacts; synthetic-label skins alone do not establish robustness.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Use disjoint whole world--life roots for confirmation and, for any robustness claim, a prospectively defined generator-level nuisance holdout over templates/skins/schedules while preserving the causal quotient. Otherwise explicitly limit the claim to the frozen generator.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The requirement that positive conclusions survive all three subscales is directionally right but statistically underspecified and should not be implemented as one aggregate positivity test.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: New acquisition is naturally a superiority/maintenance question, old retention is a noninferiority question, and cross-era composition is a superiority and causal-intervention question. Their nulls and meaningful margins differ.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Predeclare an ordered or intersection-union claim: acquisition superiority or sustained competence, retention noninferiority, and cross-era superiority with causal binding, plus a separate overall lifetime-growth estimand. Failure of any component narrows the corresponding language rather than being averaged away.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Even a successful PCFL-Stream paper cannot say that other SOTA systems generally saturate or that Dream--LoRA--Think is broadly better at long agent lifetimes.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The family uses synthetic independent permutations, fixed source lives, one model base, and specific frozen baseline implementations. This supports internal causal validity but limited external validity.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Name every compared system and resource envelope, say that those implementations plateau on the frozen PCFL-Stream range if the prospective criterion passes, and frame broader agent-lifetime superiority as a hypothesis for future standard or interactive environments.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The claim that a frozen amortized agent compiles its own life is not earned if the compiler is a prompted teacher, hand-coded extractor, hidden verifier, or target-adapted pipeline.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Such systems can establish corpus utility and memory transport but attribute the intelligence differently.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Freeze and name the compiler class, model-visible inputs, verifier role, update state, and provenance checks; use system-accurate claim language, and reserve learned/amortized compiler language for evidence that the compiler policy itself is frozen and reusable across held-out lives.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Exact corpus identity isolates semantic content but does not by itself make text and LoRA treatments resource- or cognition-matched.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: LoRA may receive many training exposures and unaided implicit access, while text receives query-selected snippets; recognition candidate enumeration can dominate either arm.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Use matched reader/candidate factorials, preserve unaided and recognition-assisted arms, report exposure and compute ledgers, and limit the conclusion to transport unless a predeclared resource frontier establishes an efficiency advantage.

open_questions: Does Rohin want PCFL-Stream to remain the single candidate paper family under the narrow benchmark-specific causal lifetime claim, with generic SOTA, on-policy, autonomous-discovery, and unbounded continual-learning language forbidden?

Does Rohin accept that three post-native checkpoints, 2x/4x/8x L_native, depths 1--4, all model-score thresholds, capacity grids, plateau margins, and independent pair/seed counts remain provisional until a separately ratified preregistration justifies them by construct validity, feasibility, and power?

Should PCFL-Schema be included as a prospectively frozen sub-rung in the paper design or deferred, with compression language unavailable from independent-cohort PCFL-Stream unless exact sublinear-capacity and noninferiority criteria pass?
Does Rohin require the confirmation claim to use whole world--life holdouts only, or also a generator-level renderer/template/schedule holdout for a broader robustness statement?

After critique and adjudication, does Rohin ratify only the exact design bytes and keep PCFL implementation, model/provider access, network calls, GPU execution, confirmation, promotion, and scientific claims forbidden until separate exact scopes and the AGENTS.md review gates are satisfied?
